repo.description: A flexible and high-performance training framework designed for large-scale foundation model training on AMD GPUs
repo.name: Primus

detail.body:
## Summary
- The MI455X DeepSeek-V3 proxy example runs attention (`PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_BACKEND=flydsl`) and the expert grouped GEMMs (`turbo_grouped_gemm_backend: bf16:flydsl`) on Primus-Turbo's FlyDSL kernels.
- Default image `amdprimus/amdprimus:tas-20261019`: `tas-20261015` + hipBLASLt from ROCm/rocm-libraries `develop` e1e7fdcab + Primus-Turbo `main` 21588d59 (#567). The image's Primus-Turbo runs the defaults; `TURBO_DIR` is optional.
- `prepare_mi455x.sh` removed; the README gives the `docker run` for running inside a container and the one-command in-place build of another Primus-Turbo checkout.
- README: reference numbers, grad norms and profile re-measured on the new image; known issues updated.

## Results (4x MI455X, tas-20261019, iterations 3-10)

| Variant | ms/iter | TFLOP/s/GPU | Peak VRAM/GPU |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 4-GPU, FlyDSL attention + grouped GEMM (new default) | 1227 | 1157 | 152.5-154.7 GiB |
| 4-GPU, TE unfused attention + Triton grouped GEMM (previous default) | 2179 | 652 | 196.9-199.1 GiB |
| 1-GPU, 4 layers | 1014 | 1400 | 119.0 GiB |
| 1-GPU, 1 layer | 443 | 1427 | 62.7 GiB |

## Test
- 4-GPU: 3 runs + 1 profiled run (FlyDSL MLA and FlyDSL grouped GEMM kernels confirmed in the trace), 2 runs of the previous defaults; 1-GPU: 3 runs of each variant.
- Non-root in-place build of Primus-Turbo 21588d59 with the README command, then a `TURBO_DIR` run: loss and grad norms equal to the reference.
- pre-commit; `tests/runner/test_docs_cli_examples.py`.
- Trial merges into `dev/mi455x_v1` and `main`: no conflicts. On the merged `main` tree the 1-GPU runs pass (1-layer 432 ms, 4-layer 1008 ms); loss and grad norms differ from the README because `main` uses DeepSeek-V3's vocabulary 129280 (#1249), as the README notes.

Suggest squash-merge (one commit message, 5980ae39 names an old image tag).

 ## Reference
 
-Measured on 4x MI455X with `amdprimus/amdprimus:tas-20261011`, running inside a container. Primus-Turbo
-`dev/mi455x_v1` (a1800137) and the image's Primus-Turbo gave identical results:

 ## Known issues
 
-- **Attention backends.** On this image only two attention backends run MLA (q/k 192, v 128): TE
-  `UnfusedDotProductAttention` (default) and Primus-Turbo Triton (`USE_TURBO_ATTENTION=True`).
-- **Silent gradient corruption on one GPU.** 9 of 29 ten-iteration 1-GPU runs left the reference grad
-  norms at a random iteration (a wrong value, NaN or Inf). All of these runs used the same GPU and
-  covered both attention backends. Megatron aborts only on NaN/Inf, so compare grad norms against a
-  reference run. None of six default-variant runs on another node deviated.
+- **Attention backends.** MLA (q/k 192, v 128) runs on Primus-Turbo FlyDSL (the default,
+  `PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_BACKEND=flydsl`), Primus-Turbo Triton (`PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_BACKEND=triton`) or TE
+  `UnfusedDotProductAttention` (`USE_TURBO_ATTENTION=False`). The FlyDSL kernels take BF16 causal MHA
+  with sequence lengths that are multiples of 64, fixed-length batches (no varlen) and a q tensor of at
+  most 1 GiB (`MBS` <= 5 at seq 4096 with 128 heads per GPU); with the backend set to `flydsl`, any other
+  call raises `ValueError`. A Primus-Turbo without the FlyDSL MLA kernels
+  (`primus_turbo/flydsl/attention/gfx1250_mla/`, on `main` since 21588d59) raises that `ValueError` at the
+  first attention call; with such an image (e.g. `tas-20261011`) or `TURBO_DIR` checkout, set
+  `PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_BACKEND=triton` or `USE_TURBO_ATTENTION=False`. Context parallelism (CP > 1) goes
+  through Primus-Turbo's `flash_attn_usp_func`, which ignores `PRIMUS_TURBO_ATTN_BACKEND` and always uses
+  aiter/CK, which has no gfx1250 kernels for these head dims, so CP > 1 does not run with Primus-Turbo
+  attention on gfx1250.
+- **FlyDSL grouped GEMM.** It needs `gradient_accumulation_fusion: false` and at most 64 local experts;
+  with the backend set to `bf16:flydsl`, other calls raise `ValueError`. Primus-Turbo documents a rare,
+  nondeterministic wrong result from these kernels, with no error or NaN: about 1 call in 130,000 in
+  steady state on the largest shape, and much more often over a process's first few hundred calls.
+  `TURBO_GROUPED_GEMM_BACKEND=default` uses the Triton grouped GEMM.
+- **Wrong gradients and NaN/Inf stops.** On the node used for the numbers above, some runs leave the
+  reference grad norms at a random iteration (a wrong value, NaN or Inf), with every attention and grouped
+  GEMM backend, including the FlyDSL default; the same node also returns wrong results from plain
+  hipBLASLt GEMMs. Megatron aborts only on NaN/Inf, so compare grad norms against the tables above.
+- **Vocabulary on Primus `main`.** The numbers above use the mock-data vocabulary of 131072 tokens. Primus
+  `main` (#1249) sets DeepSeek-V3's own vocabulary, 129280, which changes the output layer slightly and
+  the lm loss and grad norms.
